trackEditor.subtitle: Simple per-track sync editor.
trackEditor.noTracksYet: There are no videos available to edit for this song yet.
trackEditor.helpShortcutsScope: Playback, zoom and going to the start are global; start time, volume, mute and solo act on the selected track.
trackEditor.helpShortcutStop: Stop and go to the start
trackEditor.helpGuideSelectTrack: Click a track's title to select it: it shows in the preview and keyboard shortcuts act on it.
trackEditor.helpGuideStartField: The "Start" field is how many milliseconds into the shared timeline that track begins playing.
trackEditor.helpGuideDrag: You can also drag the track's block on the right-hand bar to change its start visually.
trackEditor.helpGuideTimeReadout: Next to the solo/mute buttons, the first time is that track's current position (relative to its own start) and the second is its total duration.
trackEditor.helpGuideSoloMute: Use "S" to listen to that track alone, and the volume icon to mute it or, on hover, adjust its level.
trackEditor.helpGuideZoom: The zoom icon next to the transport controls zooms the shared timeline in and out.
trackEditor.helpGuideWaveform: The waveform drawn inside each block is a real representation of that track's audio.
trackEditor.originalAudioPreviewNote: Reference track: it syncs with the rest but has no video preview.

landing.title: Collaborative Videoclip Platform
landing.description: Mybandnow lets you create music videoclips remotely. Mix tracks from different musicians and generate a professional final product.
landing.heroAlt: Musicians collaborating remotely on a videoclip

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From idea to final videoclip in four simple steps

step1.title: Record your track
step1.description: Every musician records their part from anywhere, with their own gear, without needing to be in the same room.

step2.title: Bring in the band
step2.description: Invite your bandmates to the session and organize who contributes each instrument or vocal part.

step3.title: Mix the tracks
step3.description: Combine every recording into a synced, balanced mix ready for the final video.

step4.title: Generate the videoclip
step4.description: Mybandnow automatically assembles the final video combining audio and footage from each musician.

benefits.title: Why choose Mybandnow
benefits.subtitle: Built for bands who want to create without borders

remote.title: No distance limits
remote.description: Collaborate with musicians from any city or country without meeting in a studio.

quality.title: Professional quality
quality.description: Mixing tools designed to achieve a polished sound without technical hassle.

collaboration.title: Real collaboration
collaboration.description: Every band member takes part in the process, from recording to the final result.

video.title: Videoclip included
video.description: You don't just get the audio: Mybandnow also generates the final video, ready to share.

finalCta.title: Ready to create your next videoclip?
finalCta.description: Join Mybandnow and start collaborating with your band today.
